title: Reading Section A 选词填空
paperTitle: 2025年12月大学英语四级真题风格卷（原创题面）
passage:
Most students now bring a laptop to lectures, and typing looks like an efficient way to capture everything the lecturer says. A {{1}} number of studies, however, suggests that writing notes by hand may help learners understand better. In one experiment, students watched the same short lecture in two groups: one typed their notes, the other wrote them on paper. The typed notes were almost {{2}}, because students could type faster. Yet when everyone took a test a week later, the handwritten group performed {{3}}, remembering more of the {{4}} points.

One explanation is that writing by hand is slower, so students must {{5}} what matters. They cannot copy every word, which forces them to {{6}} the information in their own words. This processing supports memory. Typing, by contrast, encourages a {{7}} of transcription: the words pass from the lecturer's mouth into the notebook without ever being {{8}}.

The lesson is not that laptops are useless. They are helpful for searching for resources or for group work. For lectures, though, students may {{9}} more if they put the keyboard away and {{10}} a pen instead.

blanks.explain: a growing number of 是常用搭配，意为越来越多的，说明相关研究不断增多。
此处需要形容词作表语，complete 意为完整的；打字快，所以记录几乎不遗漏。
Yet 引出转折：虽然打字的笔记更完整，一周后测试中手写组却表现更好；better 作副词修饰 performed。
key points 表示要点，与上文 must decide what matters 相呼应。
情态动词 must 后接动词原形，decide 意为决定，说明手写要求判断哪些内容重要。
summarise 意为概括；把听到的内容用自己的话概括，与 cannot copy every word 构成因果。
a kind of 表示一种，此处指打字容易变成一种不加思考的照抄。
being 后接过去分词构成被动，understood 意为被理解，说明照抄时信息未经加工。
may 后接动词原形，benefit 意为受益，与后文 use a pen instead 的建议一致。
此处需要动词原形，use a pen 与 instead of a keyboard 形成对比，建议学生改用纸笔。
